# <test> <seconds>: ./dirac/oracle top-level tests of >= 1 s, for scripts/ci-oracle-shard.sh's deal.
# A test's seconds are the sum of its leaf (sub)tests' run times: its cost, not its wall, so a test that
# plays its seeds as parallel subtests weighs what it plays. Measured: the ten oracle parts of promote PR
# run 43618691369 (land train-1114-1000, 2026-11-14, ubuntu-24.04 runners), the PASS lines each part folds
# in its log. Part wall tracked part cost (about 0.25 wall s per cost s: 533-1067 s for 2275-4197 s of
# cost before this refresh, when the old file's scale came from a loaded gate box). Entries that run
# printed no time for (pool-only tests, which skip on a CI clone) keep their old weights. Unlisted tests
# weigh DEFAULT_SECONDS (0.08, the median of the rest). Refresh from the PASS lines of a green run's parts
# (the "PASS and SKIP lines" group), or the "slowest tests" lines the CI parts print.
